messages:
Jordan Li: hi team, jordan here (day 3). my PR triggered Buildkite but the agent failed fetching the repo with a 403. i'm guessing i missed some onboarding step. who should i ping for pipeline access?
Buildkite Bot: Build #88 (jordan/feat/new-logger) failed  exit code 128  logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/88
Jordan Li: checkout error snippet: 
```
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/core.git/'
```
Priya Patel: welcome! :wave: quick checklist: 1) add SSH key to GitHub, 2) join eng-ci or eng-infra team, 3) confirm Buildkite pipeline membership. Which repo is this?
Jordan Li: repo is redwood-inference/core, pipeline name shows "core/build-and-test". I added SSH key to my profile earlier.
Samir Rao: hey @Jordan Li, Buildkite sometimes uses HTTPS when running in our k8s agents so SSH key won't help unless agent does ssh checkout. This pipeline uses an org deploy token. If you're not in the GitHub team that token scopes, you'll get 403. I'll add you to eng-ci and also check pipeline team.
Infra Bot: Note: the org recently rotated the deploy token (2024-07-31). Users added after rotation may need explicit team membership.
Jordan Li: thanks. also saw a separate failure later when i retried: pip install failed with a corrupted wheel message. not sure if that's related to cache.
Samir Rao: added you to org team and pipeline. Re-run should fix the 403. For the pip wheel, try rerunning with SKIP_PIP_CACHE=1 or use the "Clear caches" option in Buildkite manual run. We had a flaky wheel issue after we updated the base image.
Jordan Li: re-run shows the 403 is gone but unit tests failed in integration suite with timeout on starting postgres container: 
```
E   TimeoutError: Postgres did not start after 60s
```
Priya Patel: sometimes the build node pulls old docker images slowly. If you see that often, add TAG=ci-latest to force a fresh image or set CI_DOCKER_PULL=1 in the pipeline env. There's also a flaky infra issue tracked: https://redwood.internal/infra/issues/142
Oncall Pager: flagged infra incident INC-2024-142 (docker registry slow pulls)  impact: intermittent CI failures assigned: eng-infra oncall
Samir Rao: I restarted the agent and bumped the job timeout to 300s for that pipeline temporarily. Also queued a follow-up to update the pipeline to use our pre-warmed test DB image.
Jordan Li: build passed on third try after skipping cache and longer timeout. buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/90
Buildkite Bot: Build #90 (jordan/feat/new-logger) passed  duration 12m
Jordan Li: huge thanks, everyone. quick Q: for GitHub Actions in other repos, will I need a maintainer to enable workflow runs? i'm planning a tiny change in infra/ci-templates repo.
Priya Patel: for infra/ci-templates you should be fine if you have write access, but if the repo restricts Actions or protects branches, you may need a reviewer or an admin to approve. Best to open a draft PR and ping eng-infra for review.
Jordan Li: got it. i'll follow the onboarding guide and mark "CI access" done in my checklist. thanks again!
